utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive at 9. Bring your tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually using that old drive? Are you sure it's safe?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's safe. We'll have first aid and safety checks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we figured out a spot for collecting and storing the donated tools yet? I don't want things to get chaotic.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great question, Pia! I think Vik mentioned we could use the community center's back shed—it's dry and has plenty of shelves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds like a solid plan, but do we have a key or permission to use it? I don't want to assume we can just walk in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Mara! The repair drive's shaping up nicely—Opal confirmed the Elm Street garage, and I'm just about to sort through the volunteer list with Bo. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I'd love to help sort the list. I'm already down for the morning shift on Saturday, so this works out great.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara! Having your eyes on the list will make this go so much smoother. Let's gather at the garage tomorrow evening to finalize everything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mina, it's a community tool-share event where we bring broken stuff and try to fix it together. I think I might bring that old toaster of mine.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds fine, but who's actually running it? I don't want to show up and find no one knows what they're doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, have you heard anything more about the repair drive since I last checked?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yes, it's all set for this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center! I'm definitely bringing my toaster, and Jules is rallying the gardening club for extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll make sure to bring my old toaster then. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the community center closes at 5 on weekdays, Oren, but the repair drive is all day Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Uli, speaking of the repair drive, did you hear Gus is bringing his toolbox this weekend? He's such a dear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's great news, Gus is always so handy. I'm sure his toolbox will come in handy for a lot of people.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Maybe I should try asking around more — I bet someone like Mrs. Gable knows the real scoop on this repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I've got it all sorted by type at the community center, so if you hear anything specific, just point folks my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great, Eli! I'll definitely send anyone your way if they ask about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Gus, yeah the drive's... happening. Rosa's gonna help me sort the volunteer list, so hopefully we'll get it together soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo. I've got my toolbox ready—just let me know if you need any extra wrenches or a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus. Appreciate it. I'll let you know once we figure out the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So just to be clear, you need a basic wrench and screwdrivers—not my diagnostic gear, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, just the basics—though knowing me, I'll probably show up late and have to borrow yours!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, Dane, I'll have them ready at 9. But if you're late, I'm not waiting around—we've got a device to fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'll be at my garage sorting through the donations around 10 tomorrow morning, if you're still up for giving me a hand, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the garage on Elm Street—that's where you'll be sorting? I thought the repair drive was at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The community center is for the big meeting, but the garage is where all the real work's happening with the tools and lumber—easier to spread it all out there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, are you still planning to help with the repair drive this Saturday? I need to coordinate pickup times for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I thought it was just a fence fix — how did it get so big?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Noah, it's grown a bit! We've got a whole list of odd jobs from the neighbors. Hey, could you spare an hour to drive some supplies over?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're meeting at the community center from 10 to 4, and we could really use your skills!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I heard about it! I've already offered to help Cleo sort tools, but I can definitely lend a hand with you too. What's the biggest challenge we're facing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, we've got a bunch of small appliances coming in—toasters, fans, that sort of thing. If you're good with wiring, that'd be a huge help!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah, don't you worry—I've got a list right here of what we're fixing, and it's all manageable with what folks have brought in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Cleo, you're a godsend as always! I was just telling Gus about that pothole—Mrs. Henderson will be so relieved to see it finally sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess! And I've added a few more things to the list—like that loose railing on the community center steps—since we've got the supplies to spare.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard something about that while I was at the grocery store. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's happening at the old garage on Elm Street—I just confirmed that with Rosa. Still waiting on the exact start time, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Elm Street, huh? I drive past that garage every day. Let me know when you hear the start time—I'll see if I can drop by my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Hana, have you been able to figure out if it's mechanical or a data issue?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought it might be something like that—maybe they're trying to fix broken appliances or electronics around the neighborhood?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: But who's actually organizing this? I'm not committing to anything unless I know it's not going to be a free-for-all.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my tool kit on Saturday, got some screwdrivers and a multimeter that might come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That's great, Rey! I'll bring my toolbox too—we can set up a little station together and make sure everything's organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like a plan. I'll aim to get there early so we can set up side by side.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're gathering at the community center from 10 to 4—bring any broken items you'd like to fix!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, yeah, I heard about that. I'm planning to bring in my old blender—hoping someone can help me get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect, Uli! I'm sure one of our handy neighbors can take a look at it. And if you're free to lend a hand fixing other stuff too, even better!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I'll have the list ready for you by then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'll mark it down. Let's make sure we cover all the categories clearly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I'll prepare a checklist for the categories we need to cover.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive! I was just thinking about that—did I already say I'd bring my old toaster, or was that last month?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You did mention bringing your toaster last time, but we'll take it again—it's good practice for me to get some more repair work in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Sam! I'll make sure to bring it along this time—and maybe I'll remember to actually leave the house with it this time!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point, Mina. I'll ask Leo if he needs anything beyond the wrench and screwdrivers for a power issue.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good thinking, Hana. Maybe we should make a checklist of what each volunteer is bringing so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's a great idea, Pia. I'll start the list—what do you think we should include first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I know I'm usually the last one to show up, but I'll do my best to be there early this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you then. I gotta run—Rosa's got the list sorted, so just follow her lead.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright Bo, I'll track Rosa down when I get there. Thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I see. So we're doing more than just that fence, huh? I guess I better pay better attention.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's a whole community effort! You should come by on Saturday—we could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can probably help out on Saturday. Just point me to where you need me, and I'll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? I'll be at the community center by 7:45 to help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there at 9 with my tools. Need any help setting up earlier?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Leo! I'm handling the morning shift, but extra hands for setup are always welcome.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You really trust Mr. Chen's advice on this? The guy who still thinks Bluetooth is a dental issue?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Mr. Chen may not know tech, but he knows people and community spirit—that's what matters for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Community spirit won't fix my router when it shorts out. I'd rather have someone who knows the difference between a capacitor and a carrot.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
